stepTitle: Suppose a horse leans against a wall as in the figure, emulating a scene in the comedy movie Cat Ballou. Calculate the force exerted on the wall, assuming that force is horizontal, using the data in the schematic representation of the situation. Note that the force exerted on the wall is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the force exerted on the horse, keeping it in equilibrium. The total mass of the horse and rider is $$500\, \text{kg}.$$ Take the data to be accurate to three digits. Give the force to the nearest $$10\, \text{N}$$ (in $$\text{N})$$.
